_comment: ngsolve convection_diffusion#1 (forgetting .Other() makes the jump term identically zero). Run 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604, unit_square maxh 0.3, L2 order 1 dgjumps=True. (u-u) really is identically zero -- its L2 norm is exactly 0.0 against a field norm of 0.447 -- and the form built from it assembles with no exception and no output at all, checked at the file-descriptor level. nze counts ALLOCATED slots, which dgjumps fixes at space construction and which is identical either way, so entries that actually received a value are counted instead: the broken form writes 0 entries of any kind, the correct one writes 610 of which 444 are cross-element. A full DG solve on the broken form plus a mass term reproduces the elementwise L2 projection to 0.0 exactly, so the scheme really is 'a discontinuous polynomial fit per element with no inter-element coupling'.
